lessons.culture: The adhan calls people to each of the five daily prayers, and the iqamah, said just before the prayer starts, tells them to stand in rows. In Yemen a mosque is usually called a جَامِع. Someone who joins late prays with the imam, then stands and completes what he missed after the imam's salaam.

lessons.culture: Wudu is the washing done before prayer, and a masjid keeps a place for it, usually near the toilets. Shoes come off at the door, clothes should be clean and modest, and phones go on silent so no one's prayer is disturbed. The qibla is the direction of the Kaaba in Makkah.

lessons.culture: Jumu'ah takes the place of the Dhuhr prayer on Friday and is prayed in congregation after the khutbah. People often bathe, wear clean clothes and come early, listen quietly during the khutbah, and fill the rows by moving closer together. Afterwards they greet each other with جُمُعَةٌ مُبَارَكَة.

challenge.title: A visit to the masjid
challenge.instructions: Write and act out a conversation of at least 10 lines in Sana'ani Arabic. Ask about the next prayer and the iqamah, find the wudu area, put your shoes on the rack, ask where the qibla is, agree to put your phone on silent, and say what you do when you are late. Use at least 8 phrases from Unit 17.
required_elements: A question about the next prayer or the iqamah, using إِيش or مَتَى.
A question with فِين about the wudu area, the entrance, the shoe rack or the qibla.
أَشْتِي to say what you want, for example أَشْتِي أَتَوَضَّأ.
A polite request or reply about the phone, with مِنْ فَضْلَك or نَاهِي.
A missed rak'ah explained with فَاتَتْنِي and a closing تَقَبَّلَ اللهُ with its reply مِنَّا وَمِنْكُمْ.

dialogue.speaker: ياسر
dialogue.english: Peace be upon you. Which prayer is next?

dialogue.speaker: عمر
dialogue.arabic: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَام. صَلَاةُ المَغْرِب، وَالإِقَامَة بَعْدَ عَشْر دَقَايِق.
dialogue.transliteration: wa 3alaykumu as-salaam. Salaatu al-maghrib, wa al-igaama ba3d 3ashr dagaayig.
dialogue.english: And peace be upon you. The Maghrib prayer, and the iqamah is in ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: ياسر

dialogue.speaker: عمر
dialogue.arabic: جَنْب الحَمَّامَات. وَحُطّ جَزْمَتَك عَلَى الرَّفّ عِنْدَ البَاب.
dialogue.transliteration: janb al-7ammaamaat. wa 7uTT jazmatak 3ala r-raff 3ind al-baab.
dialogue.english: Next to the toilets. And put your shoes on the rack by the door.

dialogue.speaker: ياسر
dialogue.english: Thanks. Which way is the qibla?

dialogue.speaker: عمر
dialogue.arabic: القِبْلَة عَلَى اليَمِين. وَمِنْ فَضْلَك، حُطّ تِلِفُونَك عَلَى الصَّامِت.
dialogue.transliteration: al-gibla 3ala l-yameen. wa min faDlak, 7uTT tilifoonak 3ala S-Saamit.
dialogue.english: The qibla is to the right. And please put your phone on silent.

dialogue.speaker: ياسر
dialogue.english: OK. Where is the men's entrance?

dialogue.speaker: عمر
dialogue.arabic: مِنَ البَاب الكَبِير. أَقَامُوا، الصَّلَاة عَتَبْدَأ ذَلْحِين.
dialogue.transliteration: min al-baab al-kabeer. agaamu, aS-Salaa 3a-tabda2 dhal7een.
dialogue.english: Through the big door. They have called the iqamah, the prayer is starting now.

dialogue.speaker: ياسر
dialogue.english: I missed a rak'ah because I came in late.

dialogue.speaker: عمر
dialogue.arabic: مَا عَلَيْش، كَمِّل اللِّي فَاتَك. تَقَبَّلَ اللهُ.
dialogue.transliteration: ma 3alaysh, kammil illi faatak. taqabbala Allaah.
dialogue.english: Never mind, complete what you missed. May Allah accept it from you.

dialogue.speaker: ياسر
dialogue.transliteration: minnaa wa minkum. jazaaka Allaahu khayran.
dialogue.english: From us and from you. May Allah reward you with good.
